reviews.title: Terrible frustrating app! Used to be so good but they’ve gotta fix these issues!
reviews.text:
10/26/26: pleeeeeeeease fix the issues this app has! I’m continuing to use it but with MUCH frustration! It literally freezes & crashes with every single item I put in. Not sure how much longer I can handle this efficiency.😵‍💫😵‍💫😵‍💫
UPDATE: after a reset from Apple that was necessary to fix a Bluetooth problem, I had to reinstall the app & sign in. It immediately would not recognize me & my password which led me to attempting to reset the password. After many failed attempts to get in I was continually denied with an error. I emailed the customer support 3x and was asked the exact same questions which I answered. They never resolved the problem or gave me any resolution. I am SO SAD. I loved this app & had so many important lists going on it including a vacation list that I had built the last few months. I lost all of that & went into my trip with a partial list made in the notes on my phone instead. I will unfortunately now be looking for a new app that has better customer service than this one.

reviews.title: Doesnt Focus When Trying to Scan UPC Codes
reviews.text: I have an iPhone 15 Pro Max. The camera on it is awesome in most situations. With the ListEase app, it will not scan barcodes; if I bring the barcode close, it turns fuzzy and doesn’t recognize the code, and if I move it further away, it still doesn’t scan the code. It’s a no-win situation, and scanning barcodes is the main reason why I tried this app. Apple Support says it’s most likely the way this app is using the camera.

reviews.title: Slow and freezes
reviews.text: Horrible app. My dad used to use this app and never had trouble. However, I just deleted it after about 3 minutes because every time I clicked a button the screen would freeze or not let me pull out of typing, and I’d have to close the app and start all over again. Highly recommend any other organization app than this.

reviews.title: Shared List No Longer Synching
reviews.text:
Husband and I have used this and now have to find a new app.

When one of us updates list, the other does not get changes even after refreshing.

reviews.title: Stopped working and crashes
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for years. Is simple and remembers my items. Recently it’s been suggesting/changing my items. Now it locks up and I have to manually close and restart for every item. Anyone have suggestions for a different app that actually works.

reviews.title: Sync Problems
reviews.text: The app worked great for a while but lately does not sync between devices. I have tried all published suggestions with no resolution. I am told to submit a ticket but can find no way to do so.

reviews.title: Bugs galore
reviews.text:
This app has a clumsy, non-intuitive design. It freezes. Mail feature doesn’t work. Sharing a grocery list seems like a huge deal if it is non functional.
There is so much ineptitude in this app it’s easy to assign one star. 
Reading other reviews that are positive is difficult to accept as valid.

reviews.title: Need help - doesn’t print
reviews.text: I downloaded this app, filled the pantry. But this program does me no good if I can’t print the list for my husband to take to the store. I know you can share, not my husband way of doing things. If not able to print, I’ll have to delete and go with a more usable program for our needs.
